card.name: Words inside all-caps text
card.fires_on: Words and word parts written in ALL CAPS, usually in the middle of a capitalized sentence or heading. Typical settings are warnings, table titles and headings.

modes.label: Partway through capitalized words
modes.description: A later piece of a long word split up in all caps.
modes.example: CALLED GLOB<<ULAR>> PROTEINS THOSE ARE THE ACT

modes.label: Short capitalized words in warnings
modes.description: Small words like THE or OTHER inside an all-caps warning sentence.
modes.example: FATAL IF GIVEN BY<< OTHER>> ROUTES.”

modes.label: Capitalized table or heading words
modes.description: Words inside all-caps titles such as table headings.
modes.example: OXYMORPHONE HYDROCHLORIDE EXTENDED-<<RELEASE>> TABLETS Prior Oral Opioid Approx

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and mostly unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on words in all-caps passages, such as capitalized warnings and headings.
